trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Smooth, low-variance linear boundary in the proximal half of each lobe; high-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) concentrated on the distal half of the trailing edges.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular contouring and dense pixel clustering at the terminal ends of both lobes, indicating heavy tissue erosion or cumulative scarring.
